sources.title: Value Added Tax Act, Chapter 349 (revised and consolidated as at 31 December 2000)
sources.coverage: rate-setting mechanism (Section 24(3)-(4)); zero-rating (Section 24(4), Third Schedule, exports)
sources.notes: Act commenced 1 July 1996. This is the most recent full-text consolidation obtainable in this environment (ULII/media.ulii.org and the tradebarriers.org Laws.Africa mirror both serve the same 31 Dec 2000 base text; the current site is behind a Cloudflare challenge that blocks automated and WebFetch access to the 2023-12-31 consolidated page). Section 24(3) delegates the rate itself to a Minister's statutory order under Section 78(2) — the standard rate is NOT stated as a fixed percentage anywhere in this Act text. See vat_measures.json for what is and is not registered as a result.

sources.title: Excise Duty Act, Chapter 336 (consolidated as at 31 December 2023)
sources.coverage: excise imposition (Section 3); Schedule 2 rates for cigarettes, beer, spirits, wine, non-alcoholic beverages
sources.notes: Act 11 of 2014, assented to 19 October 2014, commenced 1 July 2014. Consolidated as at 31 December 2023 — the most current full-text version located. Schedule 2 covers many more categories (fuels, mobile money, airtime, etc.) than transcribed here; only a representative subset was captured this cycle.
